answer: A licensed notary countersigning each identity resists Sybils: before joining, an agent must present one distinct real-world credential to an independent notary, who verifies it and stamps the identity, so the network reads the approval's pulse at each later check. Forging a thousand fakes means fooling a thousand notaries, while one honest agent passes once and is then free to wander the economy without repeated proof, its approval mirroring across every audit. The limit is notary corruption and cost, so notaries must be licensed, rotated, and lose their license for countersigning duplicates.
